pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Utah GPA
helpIntro: The University of Utah uses a 4.0 credit-hour-weighted GPA. Enter U of U GPA credit hours and final grades to estimate current, projected, and target GPA.
helpNote: Transfer grades are not combined with the U of U GPA. Repeat Impact is disabled because repeats on or after Aug. 1, 2026 use the highest earned grade, which needs conditional handling.
helpExample: A 4-credit A earns 16.0 grade points; a 3-credit B+ earns 9.9. Add grade points and divide by GPA credit hours.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.0 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.EU: Unofficial withdrawal; treated as E and counts at 0.0.
gradeExplanations.T: Work in progress; excluded until resolved.
gradeExplanations.NR: Not reported; excluded until a final grade is posted.
